reports.desc: Scammer asked for first name. He then asked for information about my proterty value .  then asked if i wanted to sell and when. Wanted  also  to   come visit property.  He  did know  address.

I was cold called about my cars extended warranty that i hadn’t activated yet. I should have known something was fishy when the caller didn’t say the name of the “company” when the call started. They will ask a lot of leading questions and half full statements that are phishing for the right thing to say next.
It was an ad on Snapchat advertising for QVC on chair for a buy 2 get 2 free.

Ordered what was described as an elegant evening dress. Product received was poor quality and not as depicted, material was like T shirt material. Customer service # message was not taking calls at this time, so I emailed them asking for a return label since they have a 30-day return policy 3 times, each time I got the same message that they are trying to make things right but no return label. When I said I would open a dispute claim with my credit card, they said they would refund me 50% and I could keep the dress and I would lose the CC claims, so their offer was better. I initiated a claim with my payment source and received a resolution after multiple emails and pictures were sent.  I spent a lot of time on my big mistake ordering from this company, lesson learned DO NOT ORDER FROM THIS COMPANY unless you enjoy headaches and like to waste time!!!

I’d previously ordered from the same website several years ago.  At that time, everything went smoothly. I recently ordered the same item for a gift to a colleague and now I run into they took my money but I never received the order. It’s been nearly three weeks and nothing has been shipped.

Ordered ice maker June 22,2026. When I checked the status of the order it said it was being delivered, but it was always an issue with it being delivered. First they said no one was home, then the truck broke down after that it said it was a road block. It was something different every time I spoke with someone through chat. When I emailed asked for an refund they stop responding.

I paid for merchandise that amounted to 329.48. I originally paid through after pay. After i asked for a refund she told me no. The next day she text me an address that the items will be at. I didn't pick up the items and yet my money hasn't been refunded. I filed a complaint with CFPB as well

"...regarding a new Walmart account is created using your name and phone number, and you have charged for an amount of $1,302.49. According to our database, this is a suspicious account. If this was not you, please press one to talk with Walmart customer support or immediately call back on the same number that appear on you caller ID for direct connection." (please note that the grammar errors were in the message!)

I reached out to the photographer to book a maternity photoshoot. I found their account through Instagram, but they also had a valid website. I looked through their portfolio and thought it would be a good fit, particularly because his rates were lower than other photographers in the area. We agreed on a time, date, and general location and the photographer asked me to send him a deposit of $60. However we had not confirmed the exact meeting location at that point. I sent the deposit on Tuesday, and the photoshoot was on Friday. Less than 24 hours before the photoshoot, we had received no further details, despite me reaching out and following up. We were in contact between 9/18/2026 up to today, 10/8/2026. I gave this photographer grace throughout our communication because I repeatedly had to follow up with him. Overall bad customer service and unprofessional, and I have not heard from him regarding our booking tomorrow.

I was looking for an apartment,  seen an add on marketplace,  received a text about it but wanted a credit score on a website, sent a picture and paid for report,  she said she would reimburse,  then asked for a picture of another credit report, i never responded back

I made N online purchase to Backroad Goods for an alleged heirloom limited edition oak lamp, approximately $60. I cannot find the receipt because they didn’t bother. When opened, it’s a piece of junk made out of plastic with three batteries that were completely rusted inside of it. I demanded a return of my monies and a paid shipping label to return their joke of an item. They refused to make a refund. They refused to give a packing label, and say that that is at my expense to return to Hong Kong for a full refund. His whole thing has been a total scam, and they refuse to own up.

I subscribed to a free trial to a story site subscription through Facebook for $.99, using PayPal.  I cancelled the subscription within hours of completing the free trial, and received a confirmation pop up (but no email).  Following this, two charges for $29.99 were made to my PayPal account.  PayPal has stopped the subscription on their end, but the $59.98 charged is erroneous and I would like that money back.
